nodes.summary: Let $A$ be a regular commutative ring, let $X$ be a scheme and let $f \colon X \to \operatorname{Spec} A$ be a proper morphism that is surjective on underlying points. Let $\varphi \colon A \to \Gamma(X, \mathcal{O}_X)$ be the ring map corresponding to $f$, and let $R\Gamma$ be the right derived functor, between bounded-below derived categories, of global sections of sheaves of $\mathcal{O}_X$-modules followed by…
nodes.title: Derived direct summand theorem

nodes.summary: Let $A$ be a regular commutative ring and let $B$ be a commutative $A$-algebra that is finitely generated as an $A$-module and on which $A$ acts faithfully (equivalently, the structure map $A \to B$ is injective). Then there is an $A$-linear map $\pi \colon B \to A$ with $\pi(a \cdot 1) = a$ for every $a \in A$; that is, $A$ is a direct summand of $B$ as an $A$-module.
nodes.title: Direct summand theorem

nodes.summary: For an abelian category $C$ with a derived category and an integer $n$, the functor sending an object of $C$ to the complex concentrated in degree $n$, viewed in the bounded-below derived category $D^+(C)$, is naturally isomorphic to the corresponding single-complex functor into the bounded-below homotopy category $K^+(C)$ followed by the localization functor $K^+(C) \to D^+(C)$.
nodes.title: Single complexes in the bounded-below derived category

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
